business_scope: static beginner-to-advanced IM problem framing lesson using a fictional A-send, B-offline-25h recovery request
prerequisites: 09.02 current S2 HTTP contract and future S3/R9 proposals
07.12 authoritative history, event and offline recovery boundaries
first_pass: interrogate ambiguous words such as sent, success and not lost
identify sender, receiver, old client, product, data, safety, platform and cost stakeholders
separate current S2 facts from future m-9/seq9/E9 and B acknowledgment
classify goal, non-goal, constraint, assumption and candidate solution
second_pass: write six-part SEI quality attribute scenario with a clearly proposed response measure
review retry, 7-byte, nonmember, 25h offline and revoked-membership counterexamples
prioritize by user impact, frequency, recovery cost, uncertainty and operating cost
deliver a one-page problem brief with evidence gaps and decision owners
limit OpenIM conclusions to inspected fixed source paths
not_yet_prerequisites: real user-offline distribution, contractual retention and target agreement
